# Native annual-report table origins

`public/fixtures/annual-report.docx` is an original feature control generated by
`tools/canvas_annual_fixture.py`; it contains no user template content. The reference
application exported the unchanged, read-only input to `native.pdf` after its
full path was verified. `tools/annual_report_reference.py <native-pdf>`
records nine cell-text origins and hashes both the source DOCX and reference PDF.

The first cell text starts at 24 pt. The second row omits the first grid column;
its first cell text starts at 144.02 pt. Subtracting its 9 pt left margin places
its grid edge at 135.02 pt. These values confirm the existing legacy table-origin
behavior: a resolved negative table indent aligns the leading writing edge,
including the first cell's margin. The earlier unit expectation omitted that
margin adjustment and was stale. No production layout change is required.

Tests allow 0.1 pt for native PDF coordinate rounding. This supplements the
101 independent legacy table-origin controls with sparse rows, row margin
exceptions and direct paragraph indents. Relevant ECMA-376 Part 1 clauses are
§17.4.50 (`tblInd`), §17.4.42 (`tblCellMar`) and §17.7.6 (table style inheritance).
This reference establishes horizontal origins, not full annual-report fidelity.
